# Learned instinct: pci-tls-minimum-version (confidence 1)

All network connections transmitting PAN or SAD must use TLS 1.2 or higher. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are prohibited. Weak ciphers (RC4, DES, 3DES, export ciphers) are prohibited. Any configuration enabling these is a CRITICAL finding. In Ansible, `validate_certs: false` is always a CRITICAL finding for PCI-scope connections.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 4.2.1 — strong cryptography in transit
